proof_body:
by
  intro a z w θ h
  have e : w - a = (z - a) * ((Real.cos θ : ℂ) + (Real.sin θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by rw [h]; ring
  have hnorm : ‖(Real.cos θ : ℂ) + (Real.sin θ : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ = 1 := by
    rw [Complex.norm_add_mul_I, show Real.cos θ ^ 2 + Real.sin θ ^ 2 = 1 by linarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ]]
    simp
  refine ⟨by rw [e, norm_mul, hnorm, mul_one], fun hza => ?_⟩
  have hd : z - a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hza
  rw [e, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hd]
  have h' := Complex.arg_cos_add_sin_mul_I_coe_angle (θ : Real.Angle)
  simp only [Real.Angle.cos_coe, Real.Angle.sin_coe] at h'
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Real.Angle.angle_eq_iff_two_pi_dvd_sub.mp h'
  exact ⟨k, by push_cast at hk ⊢; linarith⟩
target_source: ∀ (a z w : ℂ) (θ : ℝ), w = a + (z - a) * ((Real.cos θ : ℂ) + (Real.sin θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) → ‖w - a‖ = ‖z - a‖ ∧ (z ≠ a → ∃ k : ℤ, Complex.arg ((w - a) / (z - a)) = θ + 2 * k * Real.pi)
